prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return strict TypeScript module solution.ts.
Required API: export function eventDeduplication(input: string): string | null
Behavior: Parse window;timestamp:key records. Window and timestamps are canonical unsigned decimals in 0..10000000, records are nondecreasing by timestamp, and keys use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. Keep an event only when that key has no previously kept event within the inclusive window. Return kept timestamp:key records in input order.
Visible example: 5;1:a,3:b,5:a,7:a returns 1:a,3:b,7:a.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
const f:(s:string)=>string|null=(s:string)=>{const p=s.split(';'),u=/^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/,k=/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/;if(p.length!==2||!u.test(p[0])||Number(p[0])>10000000||!p[1])return null;const w=Number(p[0]),last=new Map,o=[];let prev=-1;for(const r of p[1].split(',')){const q=r.split(':');if(q.length!==2||!u.test(q[0])||Number(q[0])>10000000||!k.test(q[1]))return null;const t=Number(q[0]);if(t<prev)return null;prev=t;if(!last.has(q[1])||t-last.get(q[1])>w){last.set(q[1],t);o.push(r)}}return o.join(',')};
export function eventDeduplication(input:string):string|null{return f(input)}
